coverage.note: Includes three structurally/acquisition-scoped families relevant to semantic candidates; they are not relabeled semantic.

method: Read current route, bounded ideas search/show for twelve named cards, lexical duplicate screen, targeted registry pointers and named primary reports. No manuscript images, raw target tables, models or new experiments.
global_limits: No newly runnable semantic experiment established.
179 cached text selectors are not 45 visually admitted keys; scope counts do not establish independent capacity.
Three transcription editions are alternate readings of one manuscript.
Primary validation verifies the stated reconstruction, not a broader semantic claim.

groups.reason: Image-to-word inference is an umbrella; plant identity, medicinal-property prediction, historical entry order and bathing topology predict different observations. Keep their failed and invalid branches distinct.

Both registry rows cite the exact IL017 medicinal semantic-bridge report. Count that reported outcome once in an evidence summary; do not count it as two independent failures or merge the two broader families. Primary identity and result remain unaudited because that file is absent.

Calendar rosters are one semantic mapping choice; astronomical dictionaries allow other named values. Ten-to-five correspondence asks whether the relation itself is licensed and stops before such value tests. A common circular layout does not identify an identical hypothesis.

The catchword family includes label ownership and parser coverage; FPR001 fixes a within-word ordered-root statistic on the fifth relation. Its scored nonconfirmation cannot be merged with the unscored lack of a sixth owned label.

Clothing-feature association, cross-register identity beyond known bits, and assigning English glosses have different outcomes and claim ceilings. The first two could in principle succeed without proving any gloss.

ranked_next_decisions.decision: Recover missing primary reports only when a candidate depends on their precise failure claim; audit IL017 once for both affected families.
ranked_next_decisions.why: Inherited summaries cannot establish family-wide falsity. This is a bounded evidence repair, not a new experiment or broad archive sweep.
conditions: A concrete proposed decision must depend on the missing result; locate the original report and its provenance before strengthening the verdict.

ranked_next_decisions.decision: Screen only concrete new authorial ownership/value evidence against the family-specific conditions before any semantic scorer is considered.
ranked_next_decisions.why: A new coordinate, pairing device, or independently readable value can change the research decision; retuned circular alignment and renamed formal features cannot supply it. No such new evidence was identified by this source-only audit.
conditions: Source-native ownership and readable contrast must be independently established; source admission must hold; relation packets must satisfy applicable GDT388 gates; an untouched confirmation design must be available.
Do not apply the general five-folio translation-anchor criterion mechanically to a local descriptive observation.

ranked_next_decisions.decision: Keep the existing f57 ablation, fixed clothing-feature, and fixed mansion-prefix runs closed to unchanged-input repetition.
ranked_next_decisions.why: These completed tests already answer their limited questions. Ranking them as fresh semantic experiments would duplicate work without new evidence.
conditions: Only the exact family reopening condition plus a reviewed new design can change this disposition.
